items.title: Run package build after DONE merge when CLI runtime inputs changed
items.context: Detect the main merge before/after SHA in applyDoneMergeEffects and rebuild packages/main only when source/package runtime inputs changed.

happy.desc: A DONE merge diff containing packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts triggers exactly one packages/main build after the merge and before final DONE success output; successful run reports that packages/main build was refreshed.

edge.desc: A DONE merge diff containing only docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md or other non-runtime docs skips the packages/main build and still completes DONE without stale-dist warnings.

adversarial.desc: A mixed DONE merge diff with packages/main/package.json, packages/main/tsconfig.json, root package.json, or package-lock.json is treated as runtime-affecting and triggers the build even when no packages/main/src file changed.

items.title: Fail visibly when post-merge CLI rebuild fails
items.context: If rebuild fails after merge, surface a clear DONE post-merge error telling the user dist is stale and how to recover.

items.title: Cover rebuild trigger and skip cases with smoke tests
items.context: Add a focused task-level smoke around the changed-path predicate and post-DONE build hook behavior; avoid requiring real npm install or remote operations.
